name: edge
role: The first thing the internet touches. Filters, absorbs and terminates traffic before it reaches you.

name: network
role: Where traffic is allowed to flow once it is inside: subnets, ports and private paths.

name: front door
role: Who is calling and what they are allowed to do, checked on every request.

name: compute
role: Where your code runs, and how it is patched, scanned and isolated.

name: data
role: What the attacker is ultimately after: keys, secrets and sensitive records.

name: build & ship
role: How code becomes a running artifact. The supply chain.

name: detect & respond
role: Watches every layer, records what happened, and raises the alarm.

name: identity & governance
role: The ground everything stands on: permissions, account guardrails and the rules you are held to.
